questions.question:
Find out the two signs to be interchanged to make the following equation correct.

22 + 11 × 22 − 2 ÷ 3 = 45
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/415df2b0a808d428a4a482aa6e439d65e029a1aede312ba561c35170b6744535.png] 

Interchanging the signs and using BODMAS rule,

**Option 1 → + and ÷**

**The original equation is,**

**22 + 11 × 22 − 2 ÷ 3 = 45**

**Interchanging the signs,**

**22 ÷ 11 × 22 − 2 + 3 = 45**

**2 × 22 − 2 + 3 = 45**

**44 – 2 + 3 = 45**

**47 – 2 = 45**

**45 = 45**

Option 2 → × and ÷

The original equation is,

22 + 11 × 22 − 2 ÷ 3 = 45

Interchanging the signs,

22 × 11 ÷ 22 − 2 + 3 = 45

22 × 1 / 2 – 2 + 3 = 45

11 – 2 + 3 is not equal to 45

Option 3 → − and ×

The original equation is,

22 + 11 × 22 − 2 ÷ 3 = 45

Interchanging the signs,

22 + 11 – 22 × 2 ÷ 3 = 45

22 + 11 – 22 × 2 / 3 = 45

22 + 11 – 44 / 3 = 45

33 – 44 / 3 is not equal to 45

Option 4 → − and ÷

The original equation is,

22 + 11 × 22 − 2 ÷ 3 = 45

Interchanging the signs,

22 + 11 × 22 ÷ 2 – 3 = 45

22 + 11 × 11 – 3 = 45

22 + 121 – 3 = 45

143 – 3 is not equal to 45

Hence,** option 1** is the correct answer

questions.question: Zamindari System was introduced by ________ in 1793.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 3**__ i.e __**Cornwallis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zamindari System**:

 
 
• The Zamindars were made owners of the land where they earlier have been revenue collectors.
 
• Since the settlement was made with the zamindars, it is known as the Zamindari Settlement.
 
• The demand for land revenue was fixed and out of controlled revenue (10/11) th part was given to the company.

questions.question: The Least Common Multiple and Highest Common Factor of two numbers are 75 and 5 respectively. If their difference is 10, then what will be the sum of these two numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The Least Common Multiple (LCM) = 75

Highest Common Factor (HCF) = 5

Difference between LCM and HCF = 10

**Formula used:**

Product of two numbers = Product of their LCM and HCF

(a + b)² = (a – b)² + 4ab

**Calculations:**

Let the two numbers be a and b.

⇒ a × b = 5 × 75

⇒ a × b = 375

∵ a – b = 10

Also, (a + b)² = (a – b)² + 4ab

⇒ (a + b)² = (10)² + 4(375)

⇒ (a + b)² = 100 + 1500

⇒ (a + b)² = 1600

⇒ (a + b) = 40

Therefore, Sum of the two numbers = 40.
